title: Similar RGB Color
summary: Given a color in shorthand format '#ABCDEF', find the closest color in shorthand format '#XYZ' by minimizing the similarity score -(AB - UV)^2 - (CD - WX)^2 - (EF - YZ)^2.
statement: Given a color in shorthand format '#ABCDEF', find the closest color in shorthand format '#XYZ' by minimizing the similarity score -(AB - UV)^2 - (CD - WX)^2 - (EF - YZ)^2.
constraints: Return the closest color whose channel pairs repeat one digit; ties choose the smaller channel.
hints: A repeated hex digit has numeric value 17*d for d from 0 through 15.
Round each RGB channel to its nearest multiple of seventeen.
digit=(value+8)//17; emit that hex digit twice for each channel.
Adjacent shorthand values differ by seventeen, so integer nearest rounding minimizes squared RGB distance independently per channel.
editorial: Adjacent shorthand values differ by seventeen, so integer nearest rounding minimizes squared RGB distance independently per channel.

tests.explanation: Each channel rounds to a multiple of hexadecimal 11, producing #11ee66.
